Background of Ujjwal Priyank

Ujjwal Priyank hails from Bihar, and completed his schooling in the Patna city. He studied at Gyan Niketan School, Patna, followed by St. Michael’s High School, Patna, where he built a strong academic foundation.

For his undergraduate studies, he pursued B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from JECRC University, Jaipur, graduating in 2022. His academic training in engineering helped develop analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, which later supported his preparation for the Civil Services Examination.
